measurements.grain: one row per issued boil water advisory (labeled; censored and invalid-outcome rows excluded and counted)
measurements.eligibility: parseable issue date; issue date on or before the vintage minus 30 days (2026-05-17) so an unresolved advisory cannot masquerade as a negative; observed non-negative duration at the pinned vintage; three scored windows on issue year (train 2008-2017, eval 2018-2020, holdout 2021-2024)
measurements.label: lift30: advisory lifted within 30 days of issuance, from 'Date Advisory Removed'/'Length of Advisory in Days' (label-only columns, absent from the shipped files)

hazards_measured.same_site_issue_date_pairs: 19 pairs + 1 triple; 16 pairs have two valid durations (identical features, label noise, counted)
hazards_measured.duration_boundary: 16 rows at exactly 30 days (label 1), 6 at 31 (label 0), 5 zero-duration rows
hazards_measured.reason_variant_merge: e. coli present 135 = 83 'E. Coli Present' + 52 'E.Coli Present'
hazards_measured.length_column_agreement: 0 disagreements between the register Length column and the recomputed duration
hazards_measured.regime_shift: mean advisory duration 47-65 days (2009-2018) vs 218 (2020), 143 (2021), 101 (2022), 64 (2023); the holdout window straddles the spike

references_eval_372_rows_225_positives.scope: identical eval rows (n=372), computed after gate PASS (46/46) and exact-byte --accept; holdout sealed

persistence_site_prior.definition: the site's as-of lift30 rate over earlier same-site advisories resolved strictly before the instant (the shipped site_prior_lift30_rate feature); global train rate fallback

calendar_county_month.definition: train-estimated (county, issue month) rate with >=5 train rows, county then global train rate backoff

reason_prior.definition: train-estimated positive rate per normalised reason

facility_prior.definition: train-estimated rate per facility type - constant scores on eval, no ranking information

full_model_baseline.definition: the benchmark template XGBClassifier (n_estimators=30, max_depth=6, lr=0.1, seed 42) through the runner's own train.py + validate.sh, unmodified, on the accepted artifact
full_model_baseline.replicated_by: ns-bwa-diag-001: eval AUC 0.5086 (sklearn 0.508617 / midrank 0.508617 / train.py print 0.5086 / validate.py recompute 0.5086)

per_row_diagnostic_ns_bwa_diag_001.purpose: per-row model scores preserved, so the model-vs-reference comparison gets dependence-aware intervals (the aggregate-only runner contract could not carry them)
per_row_diagnostic_ns_bwa_diag_001.order: gate --accept on the fetched bytes BEFORE any score; runner files verbatim (digests equal the benchmark clone's); holdout never copied into the workdir

model_vs_persistence_site_cluster.note: 286 site clusters resampled; rows of a resampled site stay together

replication_against_recorded.note: a second implementation (pandas-based, independent of the construction score.py) recomputed every reference from the shipped bytes; all agree to 4 decimal places with the figures recorded by jobs ns-bwa-001 and ns-bwa-baseline-001

measurements.prevalence_shift_note: within-eval prevalence falls 0.7442 (2018) -> 0.64 (2019) -> 0.4153 (2020), the measured COVID-era duration regime shift; per-issue-year figures are mandatory reading beside the pooled AUC; the model's Brier degrades 0.23 -> 0.52 across the shift while persistence holds 0.22-0.36; prevalence drift does not by itself determine AUC
measurements.headroom_finding: NO demonstrated headroom under this protocol. The runner-contract model (0.5086) trails the one-line site-persistence reference (0.6124) by 0.1038 AUC on identical rows; the paired row-level interval [-0.1693, -0.0357] and the site-clustered interval [-0.1706, -0.0383] both EXCLUDE ZERO, so the deficit is not a resampling artefact. The model sits at the calendar/identity control (model minus calendar +0.0011, interval contains zero). Per issue year the model never beats persistence (0.5554/0.5018/0.4886 vs 0.6084/0.6203/0.5991). Per dataset-qualification this is a recorded defect, not an encouraging result: no figure from this artifact may be quoted without this comparison beside it. It does not prove every competent model must lose - the persistence feature is shipped and agent-visible, so an agent that starts from it enters at ~0.61 - but the task's discriminative claim above simple references is not demonstrated by the runner's own baseline.
measurement_commands: worker job ns-bwa-001: construct from the pinned register -> qualify_dataset.py (gate 1.5.0, 46/46) on the full artifact -> --accept (artifact e8ed2a53eaf0453c...) -> code/score.py --data <extract> --accepted-report qualification.json --report references.json

worker job ns-bwa-baseline-001: fetch the five accepted assets from private staging -> qualify_dataset.py --accept -> materialize (public train+eval only) -> the benchmark's own train.py + validate.sh -> eval AUC 0.5086 (CONTRACT OK)

worker job ns-bwa-diag-001: same fetch and --accept -> validate.sh (CONTRACT OK, 0.5086) -> per-row predict_proba scores -> paired row and site-cluster bootstrap intervals (1000 resamples, seed 23) and per-issue-year AUC/Brier; every recorded reference figure replicated by a second implementation
